title: xDrip detect future data
symptom: On the main page xDrip shows the last glucose update was 182 minutes ago, and the Status page reports "Your device has future data on it, Please double check the time and timezone on this phone". The log viewer shows NonMonotonicSequenceException errors caused by non-increasing timestamps, and readings are not passed to Nightscout or fetched from Miao Miao. Restarting the collector, forgetting the device and deleting future data do not help.
evidence_quote: In Status page I can see message "Your device has future data on it, Please double check the time and timezone on this phone" Restarting collector, forgetting device, deleting future data do not help.
